strongest_angle: Examine how Johan Palmstruch founded Stockholms Banco in 1657, began issuing Europe's first modern banknotes in 1661, and ultimately triggered a severe banking crisis that led to liquidation in 1667 and the creation of Sveriges Riksbank.

key_facts.fact: Stockholms Banco was founded in 1657 by Johan Palmstruch in Stockholm and became the first European bank to print banknotes beginning in 1661.
In 1660, difficulties arose for Stockholms Banco when Karl X Gustav died and the central government started minting new coins of a lower weight than older ones.
Following financial difficulties and the bank failure of Stockholms Banco, the institution was liquidated in 1667, leading to the establishment of Riksens Ständers Bank in 1668.
